turns.speaker: Woman
turns.text: The original connector won’t arrive until next month. Could we use the alternative in the component database? The housings are scheduled for Wednesday, and final assembly is booked for Thursday. The housing materials were issued yesterday.

turns.speaker: Man
turns.text: We don’t need the connector until final assembly. The alternative’s dimensions match, but we need the lab to measure how much its contacts resist an electrical current before we can approve it.

turns.speaker: Woman
turns.text: Understood. I’ll send five samples to the lab today and keep the purchase order on hold.

turns.speaker: Man
turns.text: The lab will report back at three on Friday. If the measurement meets the requirement, our team will approve the alternative as soon as we get the report.

turns.speaker: Woman
turns.text: Purchasing sends out approved orders only at noon on weekdays. The office is closed Saturday and Sunday.
